children: FORD MOTOR COMPANY IS RECALLING 33,578 U.S. VEHICLES - NHTSA

FORD MOTOR COMPANY IS RECALLING SOME U.S. VEHICLES AS OVERHEAD MAP LIGHTS THAT ILLUMINATE UNINTENTIONALLY AND CANNOT BE TURNED OFF MAY DISTRACT THE DRIVER OR CAUSE INTERIOR GLARE, INCREASING THE RISK OF A CRASH.- NHTSA
